name: Evelynn
title: Agony's Embrace

Q.name: Hate Spike
Q.description: Evelynn strikes with her Lasher, dealing 25/30/35/40/45 + 0.25×AP magic damage to the first enemy hit and causing Evelynn's next 3 Attacks or Abilities on that unit to deal an additional 15/25/35/45/55 + 0.25×AP magic damage. Evelynn can Recast this Ability up to 3 times. Recast: Evelynn fires spikes through the nearest enemy, dealing 25/30/35/40/45 + 0.25×AP magic damage to all enemies hit.
Q.summary: Evelynn strikes out with her Lasher, dealing damage to the first unit hit. Then, Evelynn can shoot a line of spikes at nearby foes a few times.

W.name: Allure
W.description: Evelynn marks a champion or monster for 5 seconds. If Evelynn hits the target with an Attack or Ability, she will expunge the mark, refund its cost, and Slow the target by 45% for 0.75 seconds. If the mark lasts at least 2.5 seconds, expunging it has extra effects:Against champions: Charms them for 1.25/1.5/1.75/2/2.25 second(s) and removes 35/37.5/40/42.5/45% Magic Resist for 4 seconds.Against monsters: Charms them for 3/3.25/3.5/3.75/4 seconds and deals 250/300/350/400/450 + 0.6×AP magic damage.
W.summary: Evelynn curses her target, causing her next attack or spell after a delay to charm her target and reduce their magic resist.

E.name: Whiplash
E.description: Evelynn whips an enemy, dealing 60/90/120/150/180 plus (3 + 0.015×AP) × 0.01 max Health magic damage. Evelynn gains 30/35/40/45/50% Move Speed for 2 seconds. Entering Demon Shade refreshes this Ability's cooldown and empowers it. When this Ability is empowered, Evelynn dashes to the target and deals 80/120/160/200/240 plus (4 + 0.025×AP) × 0.01 max Health magic damage to her target and everyone she passes through instead.
E.summary: Evelynn whips her target with her Lasher, dealing damage. She then gains Move Speed for a short duration.

R.name: Last Caress
R.description: Evelynn unleashes her demonic energy, dealing heavy damage, becoming Untargetable and teleporting backwards. She deals 125/250/375 + 0.75×AP magic damage, increased to (125/250/375 + 0.75×AP) × 2.4 against enemies below 30% Health. Upon cast, set Demon Shade to a 1.25 second cooldown.
R.summary: Evelynn briefly goes untargetable and decimates the area in front of her before warping backwards a long distance.

Passive.name: Demon Shade
Passive.description: When out of combat, Evelynn enters Demon Shade. Demon Shade heals Evelynn when she is low on health and grants Camouflage after level 6.
Passive.summary: When out of combat, Evelynn enters Demon Shade. Demon Shade heals Evelynn when she is low on health and grants Camouflage after level 6.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Camouflaged assassin jungler: from level 6 invisible ganks, charms with a matured W mark, bursts with Q-E and escapes with R.
strengths: W charm on a mark held 2.5 s+
High burst; R execute and untargetable escape
weaknesses: Countered by control wards and Oracle Lens
Struggles vs tanks and early invades
profile.curveNote: Farms to 6; first ganks usually come after camouflage.
profile.sustain: low – Demon Shade heal when low

Passive.notes: Demon Shade: camouflage from 6, heal when low

Q.notes: first hit is a skillshot; marks next 3 hits

W.notes: mark matures after 2.5 s into charm

R.notes: untargetable, blinks backwards; bonus damage below 30%

profile.windowAgainst: R used (no escape) or revealed before 6.
checks: E tag 'heal' from auto-tagger likely wrong
